why: The canary rides in a URL a headless browser must fetch verbatim. url is required and no tool here has an empty 'required', so puppeteer admits no argument-less call. Target corrected from example.com to example.net on 2026-09-19, re-measured the same way corpus/calls/fetch.json records: example.com does not resolve from the measurement network and example.net does, so the previous target produced a failed navigation and zero egress, which reads as 'this server does not egress' rather than as 'we asked it for a host that does not resolve'. tests/test_disclosure.py found it, by checking the declared destinations against what the corpora actually name.
Exercises the second code path after a navigation. puppeteer_evaluate is deliberately absent: it takes arbitrary JavaScript, and a corpus that ships executable script is a payload, not a measurement.
